steps.title: Merge
steps.say: Merging brings another branch's commits into the branch you're on. You stand on the branch that **receives** them.

board.code:
git checkout develop
git merge issue-7-auto-distance

steps.title: Before and after
steps.say: After the merge, develop has the feature's commits too.

board.code:
before:  develop   o---o
         issue-7       \--o--o

after:   develop   o---o--o--o

steps.title: Open a terminal
steps.say: These exercises are easiest in the terminal.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.say: `cd 03-merge`, then merge. Look at `Constants.java` afterwards: `AUTO_DISTANCE_METERS` is there.

steps.title: See it in the graph
steps.say: Open Source Control: the **Graph** shows the feature's commits now on develop.
